canonicalFacts.claim: New-onset atrial fibrillation during hospitalization is associated with increased mortality and stroke risk

redFlags: New-onset atrial fibrillation during hospitalization requires immediate evaluation and long-term follow-up
Digoxin therapy may increase mortality risk in atrial fibrillation patients
Early anticoagulation timing after stroke requires careful risk-benefit assessment

pipelineDrugs.name: Vernakalant
pipelineDrugs.mechanism: Atrial-selective sodium and potassium channel blocker

pipelineDrugs.name: Shensong Yangxin
pipelineDrugs.mechanism: Traditional Chinese medicine formula for cardiac arrhythmias

excludedAgents.name: Digoxin
excludedAgents.reason: Meta-analysis of 17 studies comprising 408,660 patients showed increased all-cause mortality in atrial fibrillation patients

excludedAgents.name: Azimilide
excludedAgents.reason: Potassium channel antagonist that was discontinued for atrial fibrillation treatment

excludedAgents.name: Dexamethasone
excludedAgents.reason: Randomized controlled trial showed no significant effect on preventing postoperative atrial fibrillation after cardiac surgery

excludedAgents.name: Nanocurcumin
excludedAgents.reason: Randomized placebo-controlled trial found no significant effect on preventing postoperative atrial fibrillation after coronary bypass surgery

excludedAgents.name: Clarithromycin
excludedAgents.reason: Post-hoc analysis of CLARICOR trial found increased cardiovascular mortality suggesting possible arrhythmic effects
